author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (avg) + Pre-expert LN + Post-norm — BiGRU=160, k=7 — seed=42
abstract: Switch fusion to equal averaging with per-expert pre-LN and post-fusion LN to equalize expert scales, aiming to improve PRS stability while keeping strong ncRNA/Modif.
